name: North Hempstead Beach Park

evidence.note: Town press release: Fall Family Festival, Sat Oct 3, 12-5 PM at North Hempstead Beach Park, free, with live music.
Listing names the bands Kamellot and Dock Holiday, plus a beer and wine tent and kids' activities.
Dock Holiday's site lists the Oct 3, 4 PM festival set at 175 W. Shore Road; it bills itself as funk-country-pop-rock-n-soul.

dancing.notes: On Oct 3 the town's free Fall Family Festival has live bands outdoors. There is lots of open space near the stage, but it is a family festival, not a dance event.

description: A town beach park on Hempstead Harbor in Port Washington with a beach, boardwalk, picnic areas and big lawns. The town holds festivals and concerts here.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Bar Beach (1 W Shore Dr) is a separate park next door; not the same place. One event site wrongly calls this a Town of Hempstead festival in Roslyn; it is the Town of North Hempstead, in Port Washington.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Website changed: the current URL (/departments/parks_recreation/north_hempstead_beach_park.php) now returns 404; the park page moved to /departments/parks_recreation/parks_directory/north_hempstead_beach_park.php (Google Maps still links the old URL). CORRECTION to the existing note: the town's own page says North Hempstead Beach Park is the former Bar Beach & Hempstead Harbor Parks combined - Bar Beach is part of this park, not a separate park next door (Google shows a 'Kostal Paddle Bar Beach' rental inside it). The phone is the Town's general/Parks line (516-869-6311; 311 from inside the town). Facebook, YouTube and X are the Town of North Hempstead's accounts (no park-only accounts found); the logo is the Town seal. No park photos on the Town's site (only a generic banner of another location), so none recorded. Concerts and festivals happen on the grounds outdoors; no dance floor. Seasonal beach/parking fees apply. Current description kept ('boardwalk' is called a waterfront promenade by the town).

logo.alt: Seal of the Town of North Hempstead: a profile of a Native American man in a circle with the town name, 1784 and Nassau County, New York

evidence.note: Town park page: North Hempstead Beach Park (formerly Bar Beach & Hempstead Harbor Parks), 175 W Shore Rd, Port Washington, NY 11050; open sunrise to sunset; call 311 in town or 516-869-6311; promenade, pier, beach, picnic areas.
